description: This file is a unit test class for the EmployeeDistributionByLocationAPI within the OrangeHRM Dashboard Plugin. It contains test cases for the 'getAll' method and verifies that other CRUD methods are not implemented.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionByLocationAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, focusing on testing the EmployeeDistributionByLocationAPI endpoints, mainly 'getAll', and ensuring other CRUD methods throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the API, using data providers for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data loaded from a YAML file for testing 'getAll'.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the 'create' method of the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for 'create' are not implemented and throw the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the 'delete' method of the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for 'delete' are not implemented and throw the appropriate exception.
